title: Ever pull A few nose hairs, So solitary tears Remind you of Life still Living? #smallpoems #mb
summary: Ever pull A few nose hairs, So solitary tears Remind you of Life still Living? #smallpoems #mb
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Ever pull
A few nose hairs,
So solitary tears
Remind you of
Life still
Living?
#smallpoems
#mb
